confirmed_findings: Python owns the canonical tick transaction and state replacement.
Current Rust extension exposes fine-grained Vec-in/Vec-out kernels rather than a persistent Engine.
Python Rust adapters convert NumPy arrays through Python lists in the current optional-kernel path.
Rust required CI is absent; the required CI intentionally leaves Rust optional and skippable.
spatial_queue_v1 and discrete-agent token authority remain Python-only.
Existing MAP dependency DAG must remain unchanged and the Rust DAG appends only after MAP-PR-011.
limitations: No measured end-to-end speedup is claimed.
The container could not clone GitHub because DNS resolution was unavailable; source inspection used the GitHub connector and package validators were exercised in a synthetic local repository.
No production implementation code was changed by this package.
Future PR base SHAs are intentionally unresolved until predecessor merge plus fresh-context review.
